mentions.name: Typing Tennis
mentions.description: A typing game based on tennis where players type two words — one to reposition themselves and another to return a hit. It can be played against CPUs or friends and includes a daily challenge mode.
mentions.source_excerpt: (2) Typing Tennis (https://typingtennis.com) -- Tennis, but typing. You type two words: one to reposition yourself and another to return a hit. Playable against CPUs or friends, as well as a daily challenge mode.
